descriptionHtml:
Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 225F processor:

​Core Specifications

  • ​Total Cores: 10
    • ​Performance-cores (P-cores): 6
    • ​Efficient-cores (E-cores): 4
  • ​Total Threads: 10 (Note: Arrow Lake S does not feature Hyper-Threading)
  • ​Max Turbo Frequency: Up to 4.9 GHz
  • ​P-core Base Frequency: 3.3 GHz
  • ​E-core Base Frequency: 2.7 GHz
  • ​Cache: 20 MB Intel® Smart Cache
  • ​Processor Base Power: 65 W
  • ​Maximum Turbo Power: 125 W

​AI Features (NPU)

  • ​NPU Name: Intel® AI Boost
  • ​NPU Performance: ~13 TOPS

​Memory Specifications

  • ​Max Memory Size: 192 GB
  • ​Memory Types: Up to DDR5 6400 MT/s
  • ​Max Number of Memory Channels: 2

​Connectivity & Graphics

  • ​Integrated Graphics: None (Discrete Graphics Card Required)
  • ​PCI Express Revision: 5.0 and 4.0
  • ​Socket: LGA 1851

​Thermal Information

  • ​Max Operating Temperature (Tjmax): 105°C
